method: Every issue body and all fetched issue discussions reviewed; attachments and provider/runtime behavior not reproduced. Source findings are static evidence, not native-app acceptance.

issues.title: Beatport Genre Tagging not working
issues.assessment: No-match report ended through inactivity; discussion points to artist/title input requirements, not a verified fix.
requirements: Explain missing input separately from no provider match.

issues.title: One Tagger Not Finding Album Art
issues.assessment: Discussion distinguishes embedded artwork from shared cover.jpg and reports Serato sees art while Explorer does not; no single root cause established.
requirements: Show embedded versus external destination explicitly
test independent readers and mixed-release folders.

issues.title: Audio Features tagging should escape "(Origina Mix)"
issues.assessment: Discussion distinguishes query cleanup from genuinely different extended edits; maintainers claimed several patches, not universal identity equivalence.
requirements: Never borrow another version's audio features to fill a match.

issues.title: Traxsource tagging not working
issues.assessment: Owner identified album/art-disabled fetch coupling; current adapter conditionally fetches release details. Historical closure does not prove current service health.
requirements: Regression-test minimal Genre-only field selection.

issues.title: Quick Tag does not load any file.
issues.assessment: Old settings prevented Quick Tag rendering; deleting settings helped, which is migration evidence rather than proof the feature was sound.
requirements: Version and migrate tag profiles without requiring destructive settings reset.

issues.title: Request: Add option to treat Discogs "Style" as custom tag when auto-tagging
issues.assessment: Detailed discussion demonstrates DJs need a controlled main genre plus independent multi-value situation/mood/instrument tags, not one concatenated genre.
requirements: Keep categorized tags distinct from genre; map selected values to destination fields explicitly.

issues.title: Not matching album on discog
issues.assessment: Discussion added initial path CLI argument but never established the cause of skipped albums.
requirements: Show reason for skipped release candidates and support explicit input scopes.

issues.title: Option to recurse subdirectories when finding files to tag
issues.assessment: Recursive ingestion already configurable in CueRithm; historical Quick Tag recursion request remains useful for consistent scoping.
requirements: Use library scopes for tag work
preserve include-subfolders option.

issues.title: Catalog Number
issues.assessment: Catalogue-number output already exists in CueRithm's selected-field writer; upstream closure only says it was then unreleased.
requirements: Retain catalog-number selection and overwrite behavior.

issues.title: Dragging folder into folder field
issues.assessment: Windows drag/drop implementation was claimed after CEF replacement; desktop-specific drop handling exists, browser drop cannot supply arbitrary filesystem paths.
requirements: Use native Tauri drop paths and test Windows/macOS/Linux behavior.

issues.title: also save (beatport) track id / release id in id3 tags
issues.assessment: Provider track/release IDs and catalog URLs are selected writable fields already; discussion identifies incompatible legacy ID conventions.
requirements: Preserve source-specific IDs and expose their provenance in match review.

issues.title: save subtitle / mixname (eg. "original mix" / *** Remix) in own field, not in title
issues.assessment: CueRithm already supports version metadata and short-title output; this is an existing capability to preserve, not a new workspace.
requirements: Retain separate version and title fields and format-specific mappings.

issues.title: save beatport release id (same as track id - just for the release)
issues.assessment: Release ID writing was requested and current writer emits provider-specific release IDs.
requirements: Retain provider track and release identifiers with provenance.

issues.title: compare time before importing tag
issues.assessment: Duration policy exists and CueRithm filters native and album candidates beyond the inherited exact-only filter; unknown duration remains permissive.
requirements: Test fuzzy, exact, embedded-ID and album duration gates
distinguish missing duration.

issues.title: Nested folder support for quick tagging
issues.assessment: Current upstream recursively enumerates folders when configured; CueRithm should operate on existing selected track IDs instead of requiring repeated album-folder browsing.
requirements: Support library, playlist and selection scope without folder flattening.

issues.title: Beatport match not found
issues.assessment: Multiple artist ordering and mix-title failures led to a claimed 1.2.0 matching fix; examples were not rerun here.
requirements: Fixture artist-order, accents, multiple artists and exact remix identity.

issues.title: Quick Tag view does not load completely the first time you open a folder
issues.assessment: Initial Quick Tag load lost controls until tab switching; reporter confirms an upstream fix, but original UI is not reused.
requirements: Tag inspector must render fully on first selection and empty-to-loaded transition.

issues.title: Spacebar will not always play/stop, but press the last button
issues.assessment: Owner claimed keyboard fixes after an initial incomplete fix; this remains a focused acceptance case for the new editor.
requirements: Space controls playback outside text fields and does not activate a stale focused button.

issues.title: Mouseover text does not display in full | Scaling | Windows
issues.assessment: Maintainer attributed clipped tooltips at125percent maximized Windows to Quasar and left unresolved.
requirements: Check dense controls/tooltips at scaled displays and keyboard focus.

issues.title: Music folder location does not get saved
issues.assessment: Folder selection persisted only after leaving Quick Tag; developer claimed fix without code verification here.
requirements: Persist chosen scope and profile at explicit save points independent of navigation.

issues.title: Quick Tag doesn't prompt to save on exit, potential data loss
issues.assessment: Initial discussion admitted no close handler; later owner claimed one after a webview change. Do not infer all-platform save safety from closed state.
requirements: Resolve dirty edits on close, navigation and track change; confirm durable completion before reporting Saved.

issues.title: DIfference between Failed and Skipped
issues.assessment: Thread distinguished attempts from unique file outcomes; current code aggregates file lists but UI confusion and later reports remain.
requirements: Separate provider-attempt counts from final track outcomes.

issues.title: Support for automatic detection of tags inside the filename
issues.assessment: Template-based filename input exists; requested automatic guessing is not equivalent and could silently infer wrong artist/title.
requirements: Preview parsed values and missing fields
keep explicit templates before heuristic guessing.

issues.title: Docker ?
issues.assessment: Discussion explicitly calls server mode an insecure desktop afterthought; a remote Docker service is outside this desktop library plan.
requirements: Keep Tauri command architecture; do not import publicly exposed HTTP/WebSocket runtime.

issues.title: iTunes + Spotify API & some other suggestions
issues.assessment: Specific overwrite, edition-aware matching, Spotify/iTunes and collection support were discussed; current code has selective overwrites and those adapters, but no complete requested flow.
requirements: Use per-field write policy and version/remixer evidence.

issues.title: OneTagger - Catalog Number
issues.assessment: Catalog-number visibility differs because Tag and Rename uses a case-sensitive described COMM; not evidence provider failed to fetch.
requirements: Define native field mappings and show target-application limitations
avoid silently repurposing comments.

issues.title: Suggestion: Auto-save when changing to another track while on "Edit tags" tab
issues.assessment: Autosave and Ctrl+S were claimed added, but existing libraries need a coherent save model across quick and detailed edits.
requirements: Use one metadata editor state and visible Save plus platform shortcuts.

issues.title: Suggestion: Allow users to manually match tracks that were not matched automatically
issues.assessment: Manual review of failed tracks was requested; current manual candidate UI/backend exists.
requirements: Keep uncertain Incoming tracks reviewable without automatic overwrite.

issues.title: Suggestion: Add search field on "Edit tags" tab
issues.assessment: CueRithm has global library search, so a separate editor browser need not be imported.
requirements: Keep selection and editor attached to the existing filtered table.

issues.title: Spotify Client Secret input does not focus properly with mouse on Mac
issues.assessment: Mac pointer focus, paste and backspace failure was reportedly patched; Spotify secrets are excluded but native input behavior is relevant acceptance.
requirements: Test mouse and keyboard focus and Cmd+C/Cmd+V/backspace on macOS.

issues.title: Expose argument seems to be not working
issues.assessment: Old Ubuntu/chroot/docker exposure and dependency conversation concerns OneTagger server deployment, not desktop library enrichment.
requirements: Do not port exposed HTTP server deployment.

issues.title: Please add post-process.sh "$processed_file_full_path" script execution
issues.assessment: Request executes arbitrary post-tag scripts for key analysis and renaming; CueRithm already owns DSP and needs typed organization policies.
requirements: Use configured native pipeline stages rather than arbitrary executable hooks.

issues.title: Suggestion: Single/Releases metadata fill
issues.assessment: Owner implemented oldest ordering but declined combining release metadata with original-single date. The discussion exposes a real distinction between dates and release identity.
requirements: Represent original date separately from selected release date; never claim oldest-search result is global original release.

issues.title: “OneTagger” cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified.
issues.assessment: Unsigned-app Gatekeeper warning was intentional upstream; instructions bypassed verification rather than adding signing.
requirements: Preserve CueRithm signing/notarization and clean-install validation.

issues.title: Not writing/over writing Album Art
issues.assessment: Discussion includes transient Discogs failures and eventual settings-reset success; it does not establish one reproducible artwork bug.
requirements: Differentiate provider, configuration and write errors
preserve existing art unless selected for overwrite.

issues.title: Audio Features - Limit?
issues.assessment: Historical rspotify failure after hundreds of tracks was claimed patched; the external Audio Features dependency is not a reliable new stage.
requirements: Keep local measured analysis; use bounded provider work and per-track outcomes for supported lookups.

issues.title: No album art + No remixer name + No release date
issues.assessment: Long thread resolved ID3v2.4 visibility in Explorer plus malformed input tags and old-build matching issues; no universal artwork/remixer defect proved.
requirements: Verify ID3v2.3/v2.4 in actual target readers and preserve edition fields.

issues.title: Discogs API Limit? Change timing
issues.assessment: Discogs rate-limit discussion expands to master-release label enrichment and album artists; users report fixes, not independently verified.
requirements: Honor provider rate limits and enrichment budgets
expose missing-field provenance before writing.

issues.title: Errors but the songs found in Beatport
issues.assessment: Discussion identifies Original versus Extended version mismatch, not proof that every visible store result should match. CueRithm already has strictness and Beatport version controls.
requirements: Preserve version-sensitive matching and expose why a candidate was rejected.

issues.title: Error while installing dependencies on macOS
issues.assessment: Historical macOS build instructions incorrectly led users to apt/Java; maintainers lacked native Mac builds then.
requirements: Keep platform-specific reproducible builds and packaged runtime resources.

issues.title: feature request: musicbrainz api
issues.assessment: MusicBrainz request was historically added; CueRithm currently supports only Beatport and Traxsource.
requirements: Evaluate MusicBrainz as a separate album-oriented provider with fixture coverage and measured value.

issues.title: feature request: bandcamp api
issues.assessment: The 2021 reply says no metadata API; later source contains a Bandcamp adapter, so this old closure is not a current availability conclusion.
requirements: Evaluate current adapter and stable metadata contracts independently of this historical reply.

issues.title: Pulling specific beatport track metadata
issues.assessment: User confirmed Beatport track-ID matching fixed wrong-release selection; current implementation has ID match path.
requirements: Permit pinned provider URL/ID and verify version/duration consistency.

issues.title: Add "(.stem).mp4" support
issues.assessment: Stem MP4 support was claimed upstream; specialized multistream behavior is outside current common-format integration boundary.
requirements: Do not advertise stem support without stream-aware decoding and metadata preservation tests.

issues.title: Beatport Subgenre
issues.assessment: Subgenre/style output and custom style routing already exist in CueRithm; avoid expanding every store subgenre into the main taxonomy automatically.
requirements: Preserve genre/style separation and saved routing.

issues.title: feature request: whatpeopleplay source
issues.assessment: Requester withdrew source request after reporting the service dead; no supported integration exists.
requirements: Exclude inactive provider requests from initial scope.

issues.title: feature request: tagged date (if tagging was successful)
issues.assessment: CueRithm uses its own optional tagged marker and library outcome, so existing OneTagger marker need not be copied blindly.
requirements: Store run date and outcome separately
skip markers must not suppress DSP.

issues.title: feature request: filter results
issues.assessment: Filtering failed/skipped outcomes was claimed added upstream; Incoming already retains attention items, but the planned manual handoff needs explicit outcome filtering.
requirements: Filter attention, skipped and completed outcomes without scrolling an entire run.

issues.title: feature request: multithreading
issues.assessment: Search thread option already existed; network/provider limits rather than CPU explained low utilization. Current provider worker caps confirm bounded concurrency concept.
requirements: Use provider-specific budgets instead of one global thread slider.

issues.title: Feature Request: Manual selection Mode
issues.assessment: Manual release selection and album consistency are core trust features; discussion says later upstream manual mode landed, not proof CueRithm has it.
requirements: Persist candidate provenance
allow release selection and field diff while preserving automatic normal path.

issues.title: Feature Request: beatsource source
issues.assessment: Upstream owner called the first implementation not fully tested; current usefulness and current parser breakage need separate evaluation.
requirements: Gate provider inclusion on current parser/fixture/live availability evidence.

issues.title: Feature Request: Tag styling
issues.assessment: Separators, track/album artist/remixer metadata were added with a config regression later corrected and user confirmation; source exposes these fields.
requirements: Preserve multivalue separators and full release metadata with capability checks.

issues.title: bug: quick tag doesn't support stem files
issues.assessment: Stem MP4 Quick Tag format rejection is reported separately from autotag support; patch claimed, not audited.
requirements: Require a dedicated stem-format decision before offering those files for edits.

issues.title: 100% yet incomplete
issues.assessment: A metaflac panic stopped work while UI reported 100%; later changes mainly added diagnostics and skip markers. Closed inactivity is not proof panic isolation was fixed.
requirements: A corrupt file must yield an explicit failed item; progress counts completed outcomes rather than queued work; retain resumable jobs.

issues.title: It isn't possible to assign tags to the description field for FLAC files
issues.assessment: Requester found conflicting DESCRIPTION/COMMENT fields affecting consumer precedence and self-resolved; not evidence FLAC description is universally invalid.
requirements: Test COMMENT/DESCRIPTION precedence per target; do not delete foreign fields automatically.

issues.title: Feature Request: Search
issues.assessment: Library search already supports finding tracks; Quick Tag should share it rather than introduce a second browser.
requirements: Keep filters and selection when entering and leaving tagging.

issues.title: Feature Request: Spotify Tagging
issues.assessment: Discussion resolves an OAuth redirect mismatch historically, not current Spotify access. Optional metadata-only Spotify requires its own present-day viability assessment.
requirements: Never ship broken authorization settings or require API setup for core Incoming preparation.

issues.title: Beatsource reporting weird BPMs
issues.assessment: Historical BPM written as text instead of numeric tmpo was fixed and user confirmed. Current named BPM path uses numeric API.
requirements: Use native atom types and read-after-write validation.

issues.title: Unable to use custom FLAC seperator - existing tags not recognized
issues.assessment: Custom FLAC separator caused unchecked duplicates; reporter confirms partial fix but notes leading separators in some files.
requirements: Round-trip native multivalues and custom separators
ignore empty tokens without splitting artist punctuation.

issues.title: Feature Requests: Spotify Genres and Selecting Multiple Genres
issues.assessment: Spotify artist genres were explicitly acknowledged not to be track genres; multiple genres were later added. Preserve provenance instead of presenting artist-level data as track certainty.
requirements: Allow multi-valued genres; label artist-derived genre metadata if ever supported.

issues.title: Possibility of validate the autotag
issues.assessment: Upstream rejected pre-write validation at the time; later manual search does not turn automatic writes into reviewed diffs.
requirements: Offer confidence policy and before/after field review before applying ambiguous matches.

issues.title: Suggestions for One Tagger
issues.assessment: Long discussion favors integrated library, visible save state, custom columns, taxonomy and keyboard tagging; discovery/community-cloud expansion was contested.
requirements: Retain CueRithm sidebar/table/player
add compact inspector and explicit saved/error state
defer marketplace/cloud discovery.

issues.title: Windows installer flagged by SmartScreen and performs reboot without warning
issues.assessment: Unexpected reboot caused reported work loss; maintainer attributed it to WebView2 and disputed missing uninstaller. No installer reproduction was performed.
requirements: Install/upgrade must not force reboot; verify uninstall and dependency installation on clean Windows.

issues.title: Suggestions for use with iTunes/Music Libraries
issues.assessment: Requests integrated Music-library selection/artwork/ratings; discussion correctly separates database-only ratings from file tags.
requirements: Operate on CueRithm selections and distinguish file metadata from external database synchronization.

issues.title: Linux build fails
issues.assessment: Historical Rust stream_position stabilization error differs from CueRithm pinned Rust minimum and modern workspace; no old build recipe needed.
requirements: Retain declared toolchain and target CI
do not copy historical dependency instructions.

issues.title: Deleting Mood tag
issues.assessment: Mood deletion inconsistently reappeared; user and owner reports conflict before an inactivity close.
requirements: Test toggling/removing values, detailed-edit round trips and reload after save.

issues.title: Custom tag separator doesn't work
issues.assessment: Separator reload failure was confirmed resolved in development build; multiple genres were added afterward. Source supports separators and multigenres, not universal reader compatibility.
requirements: Round-trip custom separators and preserve literal delimiter-containing values.

issues.title: Sequential tag recording [Bug?]
issues.assessment: Request orders serialized custom values by profile rather than click order; thread also asks readable year/key metadata.
requirements: Separate taxonomy display order from stable serialized value order
keep single measured energy distinct from rating.

issues.title: [Suggestion] The ability to use Homebrew for installation
issues.assessment: Homebrew request was about installation/update convenience; user accepted built-in updater but issue remains open. It does not justify adding a package channel before core workflow.
requirements: Prefer clear supported release/update paths; evaluate Homebrew separately.

issues.title: Unsaved warning whenever switching tracks
issues.assessment: False unsaved-change warning was acknowledged and claimed fixed; exact original cause not verified here.
requirements: Track semantic edits and test unchanged selection navigation.

issues.title: Genres get cut off if there's too many to fit on screen
issues.assessment: Overflowing genres generated subgenre UI discussion and later claimed fix; half-star support was discussed but not established as cross-DJ requirement.
requirements: Wrap or scroll chips without losing access at small sizes
support keyboard taxonomy navigation.

issues.title: Feature Request: command line
issues.assessment: Long discussion documents evolving CLI configuration, Windows console differences, auth inconsistency and desired watched success/failure folders. CueRithm Incoming already serves the central automation need.
requirements: Keep one versioned preparation settings model; future CLI should reuse it without a second runtime or shell post-command mechanism.

issues.title: 1T is struggling with External HDDs or/and High Capacity HDDs?
issues.assessment: Long discussion repeatedly disproved service/cover/ID3 hypotheses; final work increased ID3 buffering. Current padding/buffering exists, but no broad runtime resolution proved.
requirements: Benchmark copied MP3s on removable drives and avoid repeated whole-file rewrites.

issues.title: Feature Request:  Chrome OS support or Linux on Chrome OS support.
issues.assessment: ChromeOS ARM64 bootstrapping eventually opened the server UI, not validated tagging; native target expansion is separate.
requirements: Do not add ChromeOS support claim or server mode to this integration.

issues.title: OneTagger does not work at all
issues.assessment: Mac webview reports were not uniformly reproducible and browser workaround worked; closure was inactivity, not a demonstrated universal fix.
requirements: Test actual bundled native app on supported OS versions; do not substitute browser success for native UI acceptance.

issues.title: Curious about how you modify the music tag or music metadata?
issues.assessment: General Node metadata-library question, explicitly unrelated to OneTagger product behavior.
requirements: No integration requirement.

issues.title: Can't add larger album art to Tag
issues.assessment: User received Traxsource thumbnail instead of desired cover and also requested track totals; developer claimed fix without independent check.
requirements: Verify requested versus delivered artwork resolution and independent track-total writes.

issues.title: Add multiple genres
issues.assessment: Multiple selectable genres were requested for smart playlists and reportedly implemented later.
requirements: Use multi-value metadata through quick editing, smart rules and tag output without joining logical values prematurely.

issues.title: Allow the genre list to scroll horizontally
issues.assessment: Horizontal genre overflow was requested alongside multigenres/subgenres and claimed implemented; current genre bar has overflow handling.
requirements: Keep large custom taxonomies searchable and accessible without clipped controls.

issues.title: Copy/paste macOS 10.13 issues
issues.assessment: Copy/paste failed on old macOS; workaround and unsupported OS closure do not establish modern shortcut correctness.
requirements: Verify Cmd/Ctrl clipboard and select-all in editor and template inputs on supported OSes.

issues.title: In Quicktag screen, where is the save button?
issues.assessment: Users could not discover Save and Mac required Ctrl instead of Cmd until a claimed patch.
requirements: Provide visible Save state and standard Cmd/Ctrl+S rather than relying on track switching.

issues.title: Make genre field editable in Quick Tag list
issues.assessment: Request led to click-to-remove genre chips, which current QuickTag methods implement; arbitrary text entry remains a separate request.
requirements: Support direct add/remove genre values in shared inspector.

issues.title: iTunes/Apple Music library: all tracks are skipped
issues.assessment: Malformed WXXX prevented reading; CueRithm checked tag loading rejects unreadable metadata rather than replacing it with empty tags.
requirements: Show precise unreadable-tag error and preserve originals
do not auto-scrub corrupt metadata.

issues.title: add option to skip track already tagged with audio feature
issues.assessment: Skip markers were a workaround for Spotify failures; feature-specific Spotify marker semantics should not be copied into local analysis.
requirements: Preserve existing CueRithm source/settings/build cache rather than third-party Audio Features skip flags.

issues.title: [Enhancement] Auto tag - Include subfolders checbox
issues.assessment: Optional recursive AutoTag scanning was added and is present in config/file-list code.
requirements: Make recursive scope explicit for recipe runs.

issues.title: [Enhancement] Auto tag - Stop tagging
issues.assessment: Upstream suggested killing app because runtime cancellation was hard; CueRithm has cooperative shutdown but no user-facing pause/cancel queue operation.
requirements: Provide bounded cancel/pause for discovery/provider waits with recoverable publication boundaries.

issues.title: [Bug] OpenWindowDialog issue
issues.assessment: Folder dialog position was attributed to Windows; no source change or reproduction establishes a product defect.
requirements: Verify native picker is usable with scaling and multiple monitors.

issues.title: [Bug] AF does not remember advanced settings
issues.assessment: AF settings saved only on Start, unlike other surfaces; owner claimed fix. Current AF persists on start/mount paths, so navigation persistence needs direct tests.
requirements: Save valid recipe changes consistently across navigation and restart.

issues.title: [Improvment] Skipping in AT and AF
issues.assessment: AT/Audio Features shared marker historically skipped independent work; CueRithm tagged lookup skip still runs full DSP and cues.
requirements: Keep catalog completion separate from measured-analysis identity and organization completion.

issues.title: Is automatic file renaming on the roadmap ?
issues.assessment: Detailed workflow requests automatic validated tags followed by rename/folder rules into an OK collection; upstream owner later claimed a renamer. This directly supports Incoming organization.
requirements: Use final metadata to organize files automatically under saved opt-in rules; retain a manual preview for existing library changes.

issues.title: Discogs Initial Release Year?
issues.assessment: Discussion notes selected Discogs release year is not necessarily recording/original-release year and requests older-only updates.
requirements: Separate original year from matched release date and expose older-only policy explicitly.

issues.title: aif and aiff
issues.assessment: Discussion resolved AIF suffix suspicion as metadata/title mismatch; do not classify as format bug solely from initial report.
requirements: Distinguish unsupported container, unreadable metadata, no match and provider error in UI.

issues.title: m3u playlists and m3u8
issues.assessment: M3U8 initially appeared broken but logs showed missing artist/title, illustrating confusing import versus match failure.
requirements: Distinguish playlist decoding/path resolution from missing metadata; preserve ordered explicit input sets.

issues.title: Auto Tag keeps skipping my MP3 files
issues.assessment: Original MP3 skip disappeared in development build; remaining failure involved mix-name differences and strictness. User confirmed newer build worked.
requirements: Test legacy ID3 input and show missing metadata versus edition mismatch separately.

issues.title: [Request] Quick Tag sorting and view options
issues.assessment: CueRithm already offers visible/orderable metadata columns and sorting; reuse this for listening/tagging.
requirements: Preserve table customization and scope while opening tag inspector.

issues.title: [Request] Option to open failed auto tag results in Quick Tag? Or at least push failed auto tags together at the bottom of the results list?
issues.assessment: Owner claimed failed-result Quick Tag handoff plus filters; this is valuable as Incoming attention to editor/candidate resolver without folder re-selection.
requirements: Open the failed selection directly in the integrated editor and retry only unresolved jobs.

issues.title: Feature: Ability to retain custom genres / styles
issues.assessment: Requester explicitly rejected merge-all as a substitute for retaining only named custom genres/styles; still open.
requirements: Support protected manual taxonomy values independently of provider replacements.

issues.title: Issue: Switching from Edit Tags, to Quick Tags doesn't remember place
issues.assessment: Thread mixes scroll/sort loss, malformed tags/audio and mood toggle regressions; user confirms several fixes but not general reliability.
requirements: Retain table scroll/selection/sort and persistent player
dirty state must survive editor switches.

issues.title: Quick Tag doesn't recognise all songs in library
issues.assessment: Current QuickTag still requires title and artist and records failures; discussion includes legacy ID3v1 and asks for loaded/total counts. Missing tags must not hide files from an editor intended to fix them.
requirements: Show supported files with missing fields; report explicit unsupported/unreadable counts and per-file reasons.

issues.title: Feature request: "Add new value" will focus and highlight new input field
issues.assessment: Focus/select-new-value was requested and claimed implemented, with no runtime check here.
requirements: Focus newly added taxonomy values and retain keyboard workflow.

issues.title: Feature request: %filename% variable for "Auto rename"
issues.assessment: Filename token enables moving into artist folders without changing basenames; current CueRithm parser is cover-only.
requirements: Offer keep-original-basename token and dry-run organization mode.

issues.title: Personal suggestions for the Quick Tag section
issues.assessment: Discussion identifies independent playback/selection, dense table, reorderable groups, filter-by-tags and destination-specific ratings. Owner declined some because of old UI constraints; CueRithm already has a better shell.
requirements: Keep table/player and separate selection/playback; support named reorderable tag groups and search/filter against categorized values.

issues.title: Personal suggestions for the Auto Tag section
issues.assessment: Ordered provider fallback already implements retrying failed matches with later providers.
requirements: Expose provider order and retry failed/review subsets with another recipe.

issues.title: Unreadable tags in .AIFF files
issues.assessment: AIFF container size became inconsistent for specific files; upstream reports patch but no independent source/runtime verification for that incident.
requirements: Validate AIFF chunk boundaries and preserve all non-tag chunks across metadata writes.

issues.title: Genres and styles do not merge
issues.assessment: Bare report says merged genre/style produced two tags; format/settings and reproduction are absent.
requirements: Round-trip each routing mode per format and make native values versus delimiter output explicit.

issues.title: Websocket (WS to WSS) reverse proxy (and/or Docker support?)
issues.assessment: Lengthy remote WSS/docker discussion added client-side browser/player and path fallback; dependency/permissions problems concern server mode.
requirements: Do not import OneTagger network server or container UX.

issues.title: Search BPM Supreme
issues.assessment: BPM Supreme was added historically, with login/rate-limit and intro-clean matching follow-ups; not currently in CueRithm.
requirements: Evaluate pool provider only after supported authentication and maintenance contract
preserve version distinctions.

issues.title: capi
issues.assessment: FreeBSD cargo-c/capi build question resolved as toolchain confusion; approved desktop platforms are macOS, Windows and Linux.
requirements: No FreeBSD packaging commitment from this plan.

issues.title: BPM Supreme support is working great except for one small problem
issues.assessment: BPM Supreme search removes bracketed attributes and matches all versions; art fix also claimed. Source implements this normalization, which risks edition conflation.
requirements: Separate search normalization from strict edition identity and verify clean/dirty/intro versions.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Preference for Date
issues.assessment: Year-only option exists; arbitrary human date layouts must remain display preferences rather than invalid native tag bytes.
requirements: Write format-standard dates and support year-only policy
localize display independently.

issues.title: [Suggestion] handle folder as release
issues.assessment: Upstream declined folder-as-release because of independent parallel workers; CueRithm already has scoped Beatport album matching for Incoming batches.
requirements: Retain batch/settings boundaries and never retag older same-folder library files implicitly.

issues.title: Total number of tracks
issues.assessment: Track totals/disc numbering were added with incomplete provider availability; current writer/model contains them.
requirements: Represent provider-supported track/disc totals without erasing existing missing values.

issues.title: Compilations / Various Artists
issues.assessment: Compilations may report all artists instead of Various Artists; provider data does not justify universal replacement.
requirements: Support reviewed album-artist override and compilation policy without guessing from artist count alone.

issues.title: Path dragging
issues.assessment: Mac text-field drop appended a path because native folder drops were not implemented; a browser text drop is not a real import contract.
requirements: Use native Tauri drag/drop with explicit replace/add semantics and test occupied input fields.

issues.title: Flac with title tags failed with error  "Shazam failed: Unrecognized format"
issues.assessment: Maintainer diagnosed invalid Vorbis data blocking decoding and recommended manual tag removal; not a safe automated remedy.
requirements: Handle malformed metadata separately from decodable audio and preserve originals.

issues.title: Onetagger deleting Serato beatgrid/cue points?
issues.assessment: Serato cue/grid/playcount reports traced to ID3 encoding; fixes claimed across AT/QT. PCM verification alone cannot prove DJ blobs survive.
requirements: Add opaque GEOB/PRIV/playcount/cue/grid fixtures through tag edits and ID3 conversion
retain exact backups.

issues.title: Audio Features customized threshold
issues.assessment: Full discussion proposes valence/energy quadrants, colors, danceability and remapping into unrelated fields. These are user hypotheses, not accuracy evidence; they conflict with the approved measured-energy boundary.
requirements: Do not import Spotify Audio Features or fabricate validated moods from those ranges; allow independent manually assigned categorized tags.

issues.title: Spotify tagging does not work
issues.assessment: Initial Spotify stall investigation ultimately implicated forced Shazam and incorrect input assumptions; latest-build advice alone is not proof.
requirements: Show which stage/provider is blocked and avoid forced recognition by default.

issues.title: Small Matching Issue With BeatSource
issues.assessment: Incorrect genre came from oldest-release ordering selecting actual bad catalog entry; similarity threshold alone cannot prevent it.
requirements: Show matched release/source/date and field preview
explain ordering policy.

issues.title: quicktag: Error loading file / No Folder Selected
issues.assessment: User confirmed empty title caused No Folder Selected; current upstream still requires title and artist for QuickTag. The error hides useful files and misstates cause.
requirements: Render unknown title from filename and let users repair tags without denying folder selection.

issues.title: Feature: Prioritize matching existing album tag
issues.assessment: Existing album is not used by generic AudioFileInfo matching, which explains compilation preference; oldest/newest sort is not album identity.
requirements: Use existing album/release/catalog as evidence and resolve compilation versus original-release ambiguity.

issues.title: Total Track Number & issue in Album Artist field
issues.assessment: CueRithm has independent track number/total handling and configurable separators; historical album-artist spacing needs acceptance coverage.
requirements: Test provider totals and native number/total independence
avoid extra spaces in multiartist display.

issues.title: QuickTag + Autosave | Error when switching directory before saving
issues.assessment: Maintainer says fix hid an error because save already succeeded; the discussion does not prove acknowledgment and navigation state are correct under races.
requirements: Bind save acknowledgment to track ID and draft revision; navigation cannot redirect an in-flight write.

issues.title: Auto tag won't find any matches when source is m3u playlist
issues.assessment: Dropped playlist relative entries resolve without the playlist directory because UI payload get_files passes no base path; native file loader does use parent.
requirements: Resolve relative M3U entries against the playlist location and report unresolved inputs.

issues.title: Feature request | Clicking in the wav form should start playing the track
issues.assessment: Single-click seek-and-play is a useful optional audition behavior; current CueRithm overview seeks while play stays explicit.
requirements: Define audition seek/play behavior and avoid unexpectedly starting paused audio.

issues.title: Tags are being deleted
issues.assessment: Current upstream ID3 load_or_new creates an empty tag after any read error, matching the reported tag-loss mechanism. CueRithm explicitly refuses unreadable metadata before staged publication. Preserve this local repair in any reuse.
requirements: Never convert a malformed existing tag into an empty replacement; retain original bytes and actionable failure.

issues.title: Audio Features + others
issues.assessment: Requests album/language-aware matching and independent AT/AF skip markers. Current single1T_TAGGEDDATE suffix means stages can replace each other's marker.
requirements: Use recipe/stage/version identity for resumability; preserve release/language evidence.

issues.title: any way to ignore "ft" and "feat"?
issues.assessment: Featured artists made BPM Supreme query fail despite lower strictness; matching normalization and search-query construction differ.
requirements: Test punctuation/featured-artist normalization separately from preserving remixer/version identity.

issues.title: Feature: Support For .OPUS and .OGG file formats
issues.assessment: CueRithm already requires and tests Ogg Vorbis and Opus metadata writes/analysis/playback; the old upstream request should not re-open format scope.
requirements: Keep all supported formats in every new editing/organization acceptance matrix.

issues.title: Auto Tag lowers case of previous genres when merge/appending, adds comma if no prior genre exists
issues.assessment: Case/leading-empty merge defect acknowledged and fixed; current merge filters blanks and compares case-insensitively without lowercasing retained display values.
requirements: Preserve manual spelling/order and avoid empty tokens on merge.

issues.title: Feature request: toggle to switch between fall back or progressive tagging when using Auto Tag
issues.assessment: First-success versus combined-provider behavior is already explicit in config and matching loop.
requirements: Retain provider ordering and duplicate-free merge policy in shared tag profiles.

issues.title: More than one mood value in quick tag
issues.assessment: Upstream still models mood as one scalar and raw output replaces it with a one-element value; custom tags were the workaround. DJs need multiple independent moods without field collisions.
requirements: Use multi-value categorized moods and explicit output mappings rather than a hard-coded scalar limitation.

issues.title: Feature: Move successfully tagged files to folder
issues.assessment: Move-success capability exists, but raw execution has known existing-target and transaction shortcomings.
requirements: Promote Incoming files through CueRithm transaction after all required stages.

issues.title: audio features error
issues.assessment: Spotify redirect/auth setup resolved by reinstall according to reporter; not a current CueRithm provider.
requirements: Do not import legacy Spotify client-secret setup into automatic incoming.

issues.title: issue passing path to onetagger-cli.exe
issues.assessment: Long Windows CLI thread resolved through correct sub-config and escaped trailing path; it exposes confusing config ownership, not a proven universal filesystem failure.
requirements: Future CLI must document precedence and validate wrong config shape before reporting zero-file success.

issues.title: OneTagger not picking up tracks in my folders
issues.assessment: Tracks missing artist/title intentionally disappear from QuickTag; current from_tag requires both. That is inappropriate for Incoming recovery.
requirements: Show untagged tracks with filename fallbacks and actionable missing fields.

issues.title: Feature: Append custom tags from comment field
issues.assessment: Existing comment tokens can map to custom sections when native field mapping matches; thread also reports light-theme contrast regression.
requirements: Offer explicit import/mapping of legacy tokens with preview
keep arbitrary prose intact.

issues.title: Feature: Regex based auto-tagger
issues.assessment: User requested reversible regex-based cleanup with live matching and preview; response about fetching BPM then renaming does not satisfy metadata extraction/undo.
requirements: Provide constrained metadata transforms with live examples, before/after preview and durable Undo using shared writer.

issues.title: new option to failed match
issues.assessment: Move-failed option was added instead of bulk Explorer selection; code supports outcome lists and moves.
requirements: Keep failed/review tracks in durable library states with reveal/retry actions.

issues.title: 1T doesn't fetch tags from Discogs
issues.assessment: Discogs 403 outage was transient; unrelated playlist UTF-8 problem appears in discussion and must remain separate.
requirements: Classify auth/rate/outage errors distinctly
never convert outage into no-match success.

issues.title: Error when trying to upload playlist
issues.assessment: Owner attributed playlist failure to non-UTF8 characters and suggested renaming; filenames with Turkish accents must not require destructive transliteration.
requirements: Handle M3U8 UTF8/BOM and explicit legacy encodings; retain raw platform path identity and actionable decoding errors.

issues.title: iTunes downloads and embeds only 100x100 covers
issues.assessment: Earlier100px limit claim was superseded by URL-size substitution and slider; source contains resolution setting.
requirements: Validate returned image dimensions rather than assuming requested size is delivered.

issues.title: "Tag same track on multiple platforms" option scanning but not tagging
issues.assessment: Combined-provider lookup initially failed to append later genres; reporter confirms upstream patch. CueRithm merge path requires own regression.
requirements: Test combined ordered fields with overwrite off/on and missing fields per provider.

issues.title: AutoTag broken with Traxsource "Error matching track: Missing artist tag!"
issues.assessment: Discussion establishes malformed store title/artist/version tags cause most failures, with some remaining track-specific mismatches. No blanket Traxsource correctness conclusion follows.
requirements: Show normalized matching input and provide parser/cleanup/manual candidate correction in Incoming attention.

issues.title: Music Deleted
issues.assessment: Historical same-source/target deletion was admitted and hotfixed1.5.1. Current exists guard avoids that deletion but can falsely report unrelated target as success.
requirements: Reject alias/same-file conflicts and never delete source before verified transaction completion.

issues.title: Auto Tag with .m3u file not working
issues.assessment: M3U import drag/drop state broke start button until newer version; report confirms update helped, not universal parser coverage.
requirements: Use library playlist scopes
if importing M3U, support explicit encoding/path diagnostics.

issues.title: FLAC support missing ?
issues.assessment: FLAC ID3 prefix was the reported cause and transcoding removed it; converting audio merely to tag it is not acceptable library preparation guidance.
requirements: Safely report mixed/invalid headers and preserve audio; test unsupported metadata layouts without silently stripping tags.

issues.title: Add OneTagger into Winget repository
issues.assessment: Winget packaging request is distribution work, not OneTagger feature integration.
requirements: Consider package-manager publishing separately from tagging scope.

issues.title: Unable to rename a file
issues.assessment: Null-byte rename failure was patched; track padding required explicit template function. Current template engine must be wrapped safely.
requirements: Reject control/null output with row errors
offer padding examples and full preview.

issues.title: Wav files not loaded
issues.assessment: Upstream later added RIFF reading/writing; discussion also found result playlists stale after moving files. CueRithm already writes WAV ID3 and LIST/INFO with PCM proof.
requirements: Preserve native WAV chunks and ensure organization rewrites internal/result path references.

issues.title: How do I install this on Linux (CLI)
issues.assessment: RaspberryPi architecture/glibc and AUR-installation thread; user-specific CLI build support does not justify new target platforms.
requirements: Keep supported platform matrix explicit.

issues.title: Remove tags button
issues.assessment: Wrong autotags led to request to remove all tags; safe selected-field clear and undo are preferable to metadata destruction.
requirements: Offer explicit clear operations in batch diff with backups
preserve opaque DJ/private frames.

issues.title: Error
issues.assessment: Invalid type string expected usize lacks a supplied diagnostic log or identified provider; cannot assign a root cause.
requirements: Validate typed settings and identify failing stage/provider without panic or blanket failure.

issues.title: Audio Features render same results
issues.assessment: Identical labels were caused by thresholds spanning0to100, not identical numeric features; custom abbreviation request remains distinct.
requirements: If semantic descriptors are ever added, preview thresholds and explain numeric versus label values.

issues.title: Spotify not working properly
issues.assessment: Discussion identifies Spotify redirect mismatch and possible API failures; no relevance to current configured two providers beyond diagnostics.
requirements: Do not inherit Spotify auth runtime
use actionable auth error states if a new provider is later supported.

issues.title: Quick Tag 10 UX Improvements
issues.assessment: Full discussion asks for bulk/dense editing, shared QT/ET state, unconfigured-tag removal, nonblocking save feedback, playback independence and faster preview. Current upstream has a multi-track wrapper, so do not describe bulk editing as absent.
requirements: Integrate editor into CueRithm table; preserve scroll/selection and mixed values; edits need not stop playback or cover seek controls.

issues.title: Auto rename: Sanitize NUL byte in tags
issues.assessment: User confirmed NUL sanitization fix and current parser removesNUL from dynamic values. Constants/path containment remain separate defects.
requirements: Sanitize controls/NUL and validate final path components for each target OS.

issues.title: Auto tag inconsistency with Discogs
issues.assessment: Pinned matcher cleans version attributes and assigns cleaned exact matches similarity1; CueRithm repairs duration filtering but not general release/version ambiguity.
requirements: Treat version mismatch as separate evidence
review ambiguous matches and album consistency
do not promise95percent safety.

issues.title: Use `lofty-rs` for tag mapping?
issues.assessment: Maintainer explicitly warns upstream tag abstractions are not clean reusable library contracts. This is rationale for an adapter, not proof a lofty migration is required.
requirements: Reuse reviewed narrow semantics behind CueRithm writer contracts; avoid wholesale tag/runtime import or gratuitous library migration.

issues.title: Fersh Install and beat port wont tag?
issues.assessment: Missing Beatport config/blank platform panel disappeared next day without root cause.
requirements: Version/migrate recipe schemas and show recoverable missing provider settings.

issues.title: Genre sometimes not fetched/stored
issues.assessment: Styles-to-genre policy affects Beatport subgenre too and can yield no genre; source clearing confirms this is policy rather than transport loss.
requirements: Display genre/style/subgenre semantics and missing routed values in preview before replace.

issues.title: Export Configuration (Backup)
issues.assessment: Discussion clarifies profiles mean different auto-tag field/provider sets, not just backup; owner claimed profiles later added.
requirements: Versioned import/export and named preparation presets should reuse shared settings validation and omit credentials/absolute machine-specific paths by default.

issues.title: Request: Add MEDIATYPE from Discogs
issues.assessment: MEDIATYPE support evolved through typo/capability and track-ID index regressions. Current OtherTags exists, but exact track-number index still assumes global release order and permitszero before subtractingone.
requirements: Validate release track identities, zero/out-of-range and multi-disc cases before enabling Discogs writes.

issues.title: Discogs track number bug
issues.assessment: Discogs vinyl-number option was reportedly reversed; provider-specific parser not part of current CueRithm.
requirements: Before Discogs reuse test vinyl positions, disc counts and configured numeric ordering.

issues.title: Rekordbox not loading new metadata
issues.assessment: Reporter resolved stale Rekordbox metadata by moving cloud-managed files to local storage; a file tag write alone is not native database synchronization.
requirements: Explain local file versus destination DB state and give target-specific refresh/sync guidance.

issues.title: Some quick tags not represented visually
issues.assessment: TXXX visibility/deletion repeatedly regressed after claimed fixes, with mixed ID3/APE tags and external edits implicated; final claimed fix not runtime-verified.
requirements: Round-trip duplicate/foreign tag records and detect external edits before saving.

issues.title: Search bar and tracklists disappear in 11f631a
issues.assessment: Search TypeError removed list and input; closure says patched. Do not copy UI or assume malformed metadata is string.
requirements: Validate/coerce metadata for search and keep editor usable after one malformed row.

issues.title: Request: Cancel button for auto tag process
issues.assessment: Closing app was first called safe, then another user reported file corruption and owner added stop. Neither statement proves crash-safe cancellation.
requirements: Cancel between safe boundaries, retain durable journal recovery and report per-track committed versus interrupted state.

issues.title: Log file for written tags
issues.assessment: Question requests field-level change record; upstream points at general logs, which are not a reversible metadata journal.
requirements: Record accepted field diffs, provider identity and restore information.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Ability to backup QuickTag associations
issues.assessment: Taxonomy-association backup separate from audio is useful, but matching by catalog number or artist/title is not unique.
requirements: Export profiles separately from assignments
restore assignments only through strong identity and reviewed ambiguity.

issues.title: Could you integrate other platforms such as SoundCloud, Deezer, Tidal, Qobuz, Amazon Music, Mixcloud or even Wikipedia ?
issues.assessment: Owner considered Deezer useful but not every similar streaming catalog; source selection should follow marginal coverage and stability rather than provider count.
requirements: Prioritize DJ-store/open-catalog coverage and provider health; defer low-value duplicate streaming sources.

issues.title: Genre / beatport
issues.assessment: Genre-only enrichment already supported by selected fields.
requirements: Provide clear recipe summary of exactly which fields may change.

issues.title: Weird results from discogs
issues.assessment: Unexpected Discogs genres came from compilation-release data, acknowledged by reporter; not necessarily an incorrect transport.
requirements: Show release context and allow track-level versus album-level metadata selection.

issues.title: Track number leading zeroes function is not working.
issues.assessment: Discussion resolves width versus count-of-zeroes confusion; CueRithm already tests ID3 padding.
requirements: Label minimum digits with rendered examples rather than number of leading zeroes.

issues.title: It's possible add other methods to support?
issues.assessment: Donation payment methods only.
requirements: No integration requirement.

issues.title: Auto Tag request
issues.assessment: Catalog number is already exposed for current providers; user discovered existing upstream option.
requirements: Keep catalog number discoverable in writable fields and inspector.

issues.title: Auto Rename and disallowed chars in tags
issues.assessment: Upstream sanitizer now removes NUL as well as forbidden filename characters, matching claimed patch. Rename executor still logs individual failures and returns Ok, with unjournaled copy/delete fallback; never import it wholesale.
requirements: Validate full destination before mutation; use no-replace publication, durable recovery, per-file results and case/cross-volume tests.

issues.title: Discogs tagging help
issues.assessment: Wrong Discogs editions and multi-provider album contamination made user restore backups; not resolved by increasing strictness.
requirements: Require coherent release identity for album changes and preview multi-source field conflicts.

issues.title: Feature Requests
issues.assessment: Discussion requests many providers, missing-art filtering, multi-folder input and community harvesting; multiple scopes have different value/risk.
requirements: Prioritize missing-art filter and configured folders
defer provider sprawl and reject automatic community uploads.

issues.title: Getting 0 tags
issues.assessment: Reported zero tags combined skip markers, provider breakage and missing metadata; owner explained several distinct causes.
requirements: Expose skip reasons and let explicit retag override markers without rerunning unrelated expensive analysis.

issues.title: Deezer
issues.assessment: API500 disappeared after fresh download with remaining intermittent behavior; cause not established.
requirements: Health-check adapter against current API before offering it.

issues.title: Skipping Not Quite Working
issues.assessment: Skipped tracks mixed missing title/artist, corrupt decode, forced Shazam and provider mismatch; ID3v2.4 was not proven root cause.
requirements: Show per-stage skip/failure reason and retain retryable files
do not recommend lossy reencoding as routine repair.

issues.title: RateYourMusic.com
issues.assessment: Owner said RateYourMusic scraper was blocked in testing; this is not evidence of a viable integration or permission to bypass anti-automation.
requirements: Do not make blocked scraping a required Incoming dependency.

issues.title: multiple disc compilation fail
issues.assessment: Report says releaseID plus track-number overwrite assigns valid metadata to wrong files; current branch indexes flat release tracks by disc-local track number without disc context.
requirements: Match disc plus track plus title/duration; never trust releaseID and track number alone.

issues.title: Live Feedback/Genius - source
issues.assessment: VirtualDJ proprietary Live Feedback provider was suggested without documented integration contract.
requirements: Do not import proprietary recommendation services for metadata tagging.

issues.title: Album != compilation?
issues.assessment: Discussion shows compilations can be unmarked; MusicBrainz preference was claimed implemented but cannot universally infer original album.
requirements: Expose release candidate identity and preferences without promising infallible compilation avoidance.

issues.title: M4A BPM & KEY Tags Issue
issues.assessment: Current named mappings use initialkey and numeric tmpo, reflecting changes described in thread; QT parser still expects integer BPM.
requirements: Test M4A AAC/ALAC key and fractional BPM through named mappings and target readers.

issues.title: Start playback immediatley on skip
issues.assessment: Immediate skip playback differed on Windows because waveform and playback opened file simultaneously.
requirements: Define prefetch/playback readiness and coordinate read handles with tag publication on each OS.

issues.title: Autoplay, skipping between different file types
issues.assessment: Reporter resolved mixed-format autoplay by finding a setting; CueRithm already has its own bundled playback path, not OneTagger player reuse.
requirements: Exercise sequential playback across all supported formats and retain explicit continuation policy.

issues.title: Platform specific settings unavailable in Mac OS compiled app
issues.assessment: Blank provider-specific settings were claimed fixed only in unreleased build.
requirements: Test packaged macOS recipe/provider controls, not just browser source.

issues.title: Feature: Tagging support for .WAV files
issues.assessment: CueRithm already supports WAV tag path with validated RIFF and ID3/INFO handling; WAV is not simply metadata-free.
requirements: Retain WAV in full ingestion/edit matrix and preserve arbitrary RIFF chunks.

issues.title: Parse Metadata from filename
issues.assessment: Long discussion demonstrates whitespace/template ordering and featured-artist normalization issues; manual release IDs finally helped. Filename parsing is input, not guaranteed correct provider identity.
requirements: Preview extracted fields, expose ignored template fields, validate whitespace and preserve release/version identity during candidate acceptance.

issues.title: OGG Files
issues.assessment: OGG tagging failure had a claimed fix with no reproduction details in comments.
requirements: Acceptance-test Vorbis and Opus metadata separately across read/write/playback.

issues.title: Shazam
issues.assessment: Shazam-labelled failure was Windows write AccessDenied, not necessarily recognition failure.
requirements: Attribute errors to actual stage and file lock/permission
preserve sources on failure.

issues.title: Musicxmatch don't work
issues.assessment: Source still uses desktop Musixmatch endpoints and recursive token retry; discussion confirms hidden API/CAPTCHA behavior. Low DJ-library value does not justify importing this fragile runtime.
requirements: Exclude lyrics/CAPTCHA scraping from core plan; provider retries must be bounded and cancelable.

issues.title: Error
issues.assessment: Reported30000second wait was historical; current adapter rejects Retry-After above600 and adds delay, but retries/sleeps still lack total cancellation budget.
requirements: Surface retry time and bound/cancel provider waits without stopping other work.

issues.title: id3 date fields: TDAT
issues.assessment: TDAT is valid ID3v2.3 companion to TYER; current code writes version-aware native dates, so UI aliases must not mix semantics.
requirements: Label recording/original/release dates precisely and test ID3v2.3/v2.4 independently.

issues.title: Quick tagging into mp4 files
issues.assessment: Initial MP4 leading separator was claimed patched; followup was a configured comma-space mismatch.
requirements: Use field-specific delimiter previews and round-trip logical values across MP3/MP4/native repeated comments.

issues.title: What is the syntax for the functions in auto-rename?
issues.assessment: Correct chained syntax is percent-title.uppercase()-percent, supported by parser; user confusion shows documentation need.
requirements: Provide token/function insertion and live examples instead of requiring memorized syntax.

issues.title: Ignoring parentheses and brackets
issues.assessment: Ignoring all parentheses can erase critical remix/version identities; user regex removes matched text explicitly.
requirements: Keep search-only cleanup distinct from written metadata and warn when version evidence is removed.

issues.title: Duplicate tags
issues.assessment: Owner attributes duplicate OGG metadata to a dependency update immediately before release. Historical closure does not prove current all-format idempotence.
requirements: Repeated writes and multi-provider merge must not duplicate tags; pin dependencies and regression-test upgrades.

issues.title: Win installer fails: missing api-ms-win-shcore-scaling-l1-1-1.dll error.
issues.assessment: Windows7 missing-DLL discussion and third-party compatibility suggestions concern unsupported legacy OS behavior.
requirements: Do not expand CueRithm OS scope through old OneTagger workarounds.

issues.title: Merge/append genre & styles results in duplicate entries
issues.assessment: Opus duplicates reportedly fixed but existing-order issue remained unreproduced; later Ogg duplicate overwrite noted separately.
requirements: Require stable deduplicated multivalue merge with native separators on repeated runs.

issues.title: Genre/Style merge uses wrong format
issues.assessment: Discussion corrects maintainer's initial claim: ID3v2.4 can use NUL-separated values; user confirmed literal escape option. Destination compatibility differs from logical metadata.
requirements: Model arrays internally and offer explicit native/separator output policy with destination compatibility tests.

issues.title: Auto Tag Completes instantly with Zero Matched, Zero Failed, and Zero Skipped
issues.assessment: Discogs Unauthorized produced zero outcomes until token replaced; batch source creation can skip provider entirely on initialization failure.
requirements: Count/auth-report every input and distinguish configuration failure from successful empty batch.

issues.title: Still does not work with OGG
issues.assessment: OGG detection seemed broken but ultimately changed settings worked; no confirmed container root cause or general fix.
requirements: Report discovery count and effective field policy
test artwork-only Ogg ingestion explicitly.

issues.title: One Stalling One Locked Tracks
issues.assessment: WS disconnect was attributed to environment without a verified cause; no evidence supports blaming corrupt files or antivirus categorically.
requirements: Persist jobs independently of view transport; reconnect/reload must recover progress and actionable pending status.

issues.title: Problem running One Tagger my other computer??
issues.assessment: White window/websocket and first-run failures remained unreproduced; logs exposed credentials in historical report.
requirements: Use Tauri IPC and sanitized diagnostics; preserve actionable first-run failure states.

issues.title: Language Comment Field
issues.assessment: CueRithm vendored ID3 defaults eng and exposes custom comment language; historical xxx incompatibility addressed in source.
requirements: Test default and configured comment language with independent readers
preserve named comments.

issues.title: OneTagger Audio Tagging stops at 8%
issues.assessment: User later attributed freezing to files but supplied no reproducible fixture or root cause.
requirements: Track per-file bounded stages and diagnostics; one unreadable input cannot make entire batch look complete.

issues.title: Error when trying to open folder in quick tag
issues.assessment: WAV RIFF and AIFF pacmog parser panics killed websocket/player; fixes claimed per-parser, not proof all malformed files isolated.
requirements: One malformed file must not crash or permanently lock a batch/player.

issues.title: Using an external player
issues.assessment: External player works but loses focus/control; CueRithm already has persistent bundled-format playback.
requirements: Prefer reliable built-in player
defer external-player automation.

issues.title: Universal Linux package support?
issues.assessment: Owner declined maintaining many package formats; this is distribution scope rather than a tagging feature.
requirements: Keep clean-machine Linux package validation; new channels require explicit maintenance value.

issues.title: Feature add or maybe something I dont know how to do
issues.assessment: Multi-file QuickTag was absent when reported and now exists in QTMultiTrack; requested copy/paste-between-files is not confirmed implemented.
requirements: Support batch semantic edits and explicit copy selected fields without copying identity/cues blindly.

issues.title: Request for a few more sites to get album covers from
issues.assessment: Additional cover sources need separate maintenance/auth value assessment; not every streaming catalog improves DJ coverage.
requirements: Add providers only for coverage gain with sustainable access
retain manual artwork override.

issues.title: Tag songs with the Explicit Flag
issues.assessment: Discussion correctly warns same-name clean/explicit versions may match ambiguously; a catalog flag is not audio verification. Dedicated advisory tags were later claimed added.
requirements: Expose explicitness as sourced metadata with uncertainty; never assert a track is clean solely from a fuzzy match or alter title destructively.

issues.title: Tags won't write on .m4a files
issues.assessment: M4A/ALAC forced-recognition zero-result problem had a claimed fix without technical detail.
requirements: Test ALAC decoding/recognition independently from AAC despite shared container.

issues.title: Capitalise Spotify Genres
issues.assessment: Capitalization option already exposed in CueRithm independent of Spotify provider.
requirements: Apply configured capitalization while preserving intentional acronyms through canonical rules.

issues.title: Move Comment to Tag in Rekordbox
issues.assessment: Comments versus Rekordbox MyTag are distinct storage contracts; later comment suggests comment-format import but provides no verified hardware result.
requirements: Map categorized tags through native sync contracts; label file fields versus database-only MyTags and verify player filtering separately.

issues.title: Auto Rename issue
issues.assessment: Current input/output controls call updatePreview, matching claimed stale-path fix; async stale replies and full-batch preview remain separate work.
requirements: Invalidate preview on every input/template/policy change and bind apply to current plan.

issues.title: They have just updated the beatport page and it is not displaying the tracks.
issues.assessment: Old Beatport SSR breakage differs from current CueRithm catalog API adapter; later source fix does not prove present live provider health.
requirements: Retain request/schema fixture diagnostics and provider health status
separate no match from broken transport.

issues.title: autorename doesnt fill bpm
issues.assessment: M4A BPM empty-template report was claimed fixed; current template uses generic BPM mapping, but no runtime proof for reported files exists.
requirements: Resolve rename values from CueRithm measured metadata with explicit source policy; test precision and missing-value output for M4A.

issues.title: Beatport tagging not works
issues.assessment: 2023 Beatport redesign broke adapter; issue closed with planned fix and related thread pointer, not live proof.
requirements: Use schema fixtures and current provider smoke evidence before release.

issues.title: Beatport Fail
issues.assessment: Historical Beatport site migration invalidated old releases; CueRithm selected API transport supersedes this parser path.
requirements: Document supported adapter version and surface maintenance failures without silently writing fallback data.

issues.title: BEATPORT automatic tagging does not work
issues.assessment: Historical Beatport site change was claimed patched; repeated newer breakages mean this closure is not current health evidence.
requirements: Use parser-version fixtures and distinct provider-unavailable errors rather than no-match.

issues.title: Unable to Match Songs to Beatport when Beatport includes (Extended Mix) in the Title
issues.assessment: Ignore-version Beatport setting exists to obtain genre from another edition; this is intentional relaxed matching, not exact identity.
requirements: Permit field-limited relaxation only with explicit policy and edition mismatch notice.

issues.title: Beatport Failures
issues.assessment: Duplicate historical Beatport upgrade outage; current catalog API path is source-addressed, not a live uptime guarantee.
requirements: Retain provider regression fixtures and explicit unavailable state.

issues.title: Beatport Auto Tag Issue
issues.assessment: Historical redesign broke matching and owner cited an unreleased fix; current parser must be checked independently.
requirements: Verify exact selected parser against present responses before enabling provider.

issues.title: Audiobooks
issues.assessment: Audible/audiobook tagging declined as outside DJ scope.
requirements: Exclude audiobook providers/author-narrator workflows.

issues.title: Auto Rename empty output folder
issues.assessment: Current upstream generate normalizes blank output to input and has keep_subfolders; incident fixes exist in source but safety journal absent.
requirements: Separate in-place rename from organize
preserve relative subfolders and never resolve empty destination against app cwd.

issues.title: Latest build is force closing due to WebView2
issues.assessment: Owner/user reported WebView2 access-denied fix; no current reproduction establishes matching Tauri risk.
requirements: Clean Windows startup/install tests and useful startup diagnostics remain release gates.

issues.title: Missing webkit2gtk
issues.assessment: WebKit4.0versus4.1 dependency failures persisted across distros, later user reported Actions build worked.
requirements: Validate installed Linux package on clean supported systems; no user decoder installation.

issues.title: Feature request: Auto Rename Parent Folder Variable (ex: %parentfolder%)
issues.assessment: Parent/absolute-path template functions are useful but can escape destination roots when reused without validation.
requirements: Expose safe parent/basename tokens
validate rendered relative paths and chosen root containment.

issues.title: Audio Features not placing tags
issues.assessment: User cleared comments to make historical Audio Features overwrite work; root cause was not established. Deleting user comments is not a valid integration strategy.
requirements: Do not import Spotify Audio Features; any shared-field metadata merge must preserve unrelated values.

issues.title: No issue - just a note to say this is f***ing brilliant!!
issues.assessment: Users emphasize personal taxonomy and interoperable DJ tags as more valuable than internet metadata alone; no defect to fix.
requirements: Prioritize curation/export compatibility alongside automatic enrichment.

issues.title: Bug Report: Blocking recursive search not interruptible for Quick Tag; no filter for file types?
issues.assessment: Recursive scan blocks navigation; upstream caps500 rather than true cancel/lazy metadata. CueRithm DB/paging is a better base.
requirements: Keep discovery cancellable and incremental
test huge trees, changing scope and clear progress.

issues.title: Feature Request: Chained platform sources with different tags extracted [via ISRC]
issues.assessment: Discussion separates identification success from optional enrichment failures and notes some sources support ISRC. Existing ordered merge is useful but lacks explicit per-field secondary policy.
requirements: Per-provider field selection and required/optional roles; aggregate track success independently from enrichment outcomes with provenance.

issues.title: Bug Report: Auto-Tag 'success' 'failure' counts and m3u lists are both incorrect for multiple platforms
issues.assessment: Owner claimed counts/timing fix; current aggregation records successful files uniquely but failure vector can duplicate a path across providers before success.
requirements: Use unique final outcomes and separate provider attempt history.

issues.title: Feature Request: Canonicalization and Genre tree additions (possibly other tags/attributes)
issues.assessment: Canonical genres and hierarchical/multiple-parent expansion have direct library value; current cleanup supplies mappings but not a universal genre graph.
requirements: Extend existing canonical taxonomy deliberately
run normalization after enrichment and expose reviewed parent expansion.

issues.title: Feature Request: Release URL
issues.assessment: A distinct release URL was requested but current track/release URL often suffices; storage name and consuming app were not established.
requirements: Retain provider track and release identities in provenance; add exported field only for a concrete consumer.

issues.title: manual tagger currently has only a empty window
issues.assessment: Empty modal/config/feedback and duplicate candidate problems were fixed iteratively; user confirmed results. Current UI shows version/error/loading and manual backend dedup uses whole TrackMatch equality.
requirements: Deduplicate by provider track identity while preserving all match reasons; explicit loading/empty/error states.

issues.title: feature request: also show release date and label/publiusher in manual tag window
issues.assessment: Manual results omit date/label because detail enrichment occurs only during apply; this weakens informed selection.
requirements: Fetch detail lazily on candidate selection before field preview, with bounded cache and loading/error state.

issues.title: additional sources
issues.assessment: Bare Tidal/Qobuz request supplies no unique metadata/coverage case or implementation evidence.
requirements: Require marginal coverage and stable permitted API access before adding streaming catalogs.

issues.title: CLI - Auto renamer overwrite should not change files folder
issues.assessment: CLI keep-subfolders flag existed in newer build and user confirmed behavior; default flattening was unexpected.
requirements: Default Incoming organization policy explicitly and preview hierarchy changes.

issues.title: Ventura 13.5 setup
issues.assessment: Setup/reinstall resolved no-start; later question shows confusion about provider versus measured audio-feature writes.
requirements: Show effective pipeline and stages before processing
measured DSP remains independent of catalog enrichment.

issues.title: Feature request : specify features by source
issues.assessment: Discussion clarifies per-source field choices; upstream workaround of reorder/no-overwrite/genre-merge is insufficient for all source-specific authority policies.
requirements: Use compact field-source overrides in existing Settings rather than repeated manual runs.

issues.title: 4 star rating not reflecting in metadata
issues.assessment: Four-star foobar mismatch lacks format/plugin details and reproduction; no fix established.
requirements: Fixture rating mappings for intended readers instead of assuming one universal scale.

issues.title: error "invalid utf-8 sequence of 1 bytes from index 73"
issues.assessment: Foobar M3U encoding triggers invalid UTF8 and poisons subsequent attempts until restart; alternate exporter works.
requirements: Support M3U8 plus explicit legacy encoding handling
isolate bad playlist errors from later jobs.

issues.title: Inaccurate tags in few tracks
issues.assessment: Owner/user tied remix-versus-original mismatch to version matching; CueRithm already exposes version policy and matcher tests.
requirements: Keep ignore-version off by default and surface mismatched versions before acceptance.

issues.title: Many files open errors
issues.assessment: Maintainer attributes playback error to invalid MP3 frames; tags still editable. Repaired external file reportedly played.
requirements: Separate decoder health from metadata editing and avoid destructive automatic repair.

issues.title: Using Quick tag separators
issues.assessment: Slash separator lost values after reopen; patch claimed on different branch, not independently verified.
requirements: Round-trip configured separators after restart without merging or discarding native values.

issues.title: ratingwmp to popularimeter
issues.assessment: User expected POPM preservation while maintainer says POPM and WMP are both written; no sample resolves discrepancy.
requirements: Preserve rating ownership/scale and test per-format interoperable values; do not equate rating with measured energy.

issues.title: Mood tag not enabled
issues.assessment: Long thread established mood availability had effectively disappeared from BPMSupreme, considered paid providers, and attached a prototype Musiio Python script that marks all results successful. It also reports total-field loss with claimed fix. Current native provider declaration alone does not establish mood coverage; current checkout has no Python runtime.
