requirements: Keep manual mood curation; defer paid audio-upload mood service until validated API, billing and failure model exist.

issues.title: undo
issues.assessment: Undo request conflicts with upstream direct-write rationale; CueRithm already has durable backup primitives and cleanup undo.
requirements: Provide history/undo for manual tag and organization changes with stale-byte checks.

issues.title: Use Without Audio Files
issues.assessment: CSV-only radio metadata enrichment is outside the local-audio Incoming/library goal; creating dummy audio is not a suitable product workaround.
requirements: No synthetic placeholder audio in library to request catalog data.

issues.title: Ignoring folders with certain UTF-8 characters present
issues.assessment: Valid Unicode Windows foldernames ignored; owner suggested path-handling changes but no confirmation.
requirements: Test Unicode/NFC/NFD/long paths and preserve raw path identity through file operations.

issues.title: Skipped track =/= Failed track
issues.assessment: Already-tagged tracks entered failed folders; developer claimed later fix without audit.
requirements: Separate matched, no-match, already-tagged, cancelled and failed outcomes
never route skipped as failure automatically.

issues.title: Shazam fails in the Android App
issues.assessment: Android discussion covers decoder/writing permissions and disabled artwork setting; approved target remains desktop, not an Android port.
requirements: Do not add mobile permissions/packaging to this plan.

issues.title: Unable to Play M4A Files: Invalid Data Type Error
issues.assessment: Invalid Data Type playback fix was claimed, but later commenter still requests remedy.
requirements: Use CueRithm bundled decoding and test AAC/ALAC variations rather than reuse player.

issues.title: MusicBrainz Correct Tagging
issues.assessment: Featured artist display punctuation differs from native artist arrays; join text is not musical identity.
requirements: Preserve contributor arrays and separate display separator from provider search normalization.

issues.title: Quick Tag Custom section field selection not retained when moving sections in settings
issues.assessment: Reordering named sections swapped destination fields; owner claimed fix, but stable identity must be designed in CueRithm rather than index-bound copying.
requirements: Give tag groups stable IDs and move entire group configuration atomically.

issues.title: How to build on linux? - Lots of compilation errors related to pyembedded
issues.assessment: Historical Python-extension branch required generation steps; current workspace omits Python crate. A thread about that branch is not proof current extension support exists.
requirements: Do not introduce embedded Python runtime for tagging adapters.

issues.title: How to generate python bindings
issues.assessment: Python integration is internal provider scripting, not supported standalone bindings; inappropriate dependency for installed CueRithm.
requirements: Use Rust provider interfaces
do not add Python runtime to desktop tagging.

issues.title: ID3v2: Frame isn't long enough to extract the necessary information
issues.assessment: AIFF parser rejected tags after AutoTag while other players read them; transcoding to FLAC avoided symptoms but did not prove cause or repair.
requirements: Round-trip AIFF tags and playback after edits; preserve original bytes and reject malformed output before publication.

issues.title: Getting garbage text showing up in the quick tag section
issues.assessment: iTunNORM technical comments appeared as user taxonomy; current QuickTag reads generic COMM and no semantic separation is evident.
requirements: Preserve technical comment records and distinguish user notes from normalization payloads.

issues.title: Copy/Paste keyboard shortcuts don't work in the Edit Tags searchbar with MacOSX
issues.assessment: Mac editor clipboard fix predates stable release, confusing users; no current CueRithm failure inferred.
requirements: Verify Cmd/Ctrl clipboard and text select-all without global shortcut interception.

issues.title: Unexpected frame, header error when trying to play a track
issues.assessment: Strict decoder versus tolerant players was maintainer's explanation, followed by claimed fix; no provided fixture verifies it.
requirements: Use existing bundled decoder and actionable per-file errors; tagging UI must remain usable if playback fails.

issues.title: Auto-tagger stuck at 20%
issues.assessment: Hours-long freeze persisted after latest-build advice; logs did not establish cause and no final fix was confirmed.
requirements: Persist stage progress, isolate per-file errors and make cancel/retry effective.

issues.title: Moving settings from PC to Mac and vice versa
issues.assessment: Copying whole settings JSON transfers local paths and secrets as well as taxonomy; a portable profile needs narrower data.
requirements: Export versioned portable tagging/organization profiles without credentials or machine-specific roots.

issues.title: Matching should take more meta data fields as input (Album, GUIDs, ...)
issues.assessment: Per-track matching split albums and ignored a pinned release ID unless track titles matched; manual candidate selection was proposed. CueRithm's existing Beatport batch matching helps but is not general release pinning.
requirements: Support explicit release pin/track assignment and version-aware candidate review; never silently replace a pinned ID with a different release.

issues.title: About the general skills
issues.assessment: Broad discussion distinguishes remote tags from DSP/cues and file metadata from streaming/database management. It supports CueRithm integration direction, not a OneTagger cue implementation.
requirements: Keep existing CueRithm analysis/cues and integrate enrichment without adding unsupported automatic descriptors.

issues.title: Choosing a folder with a ' ' character fails to resolve path OSX
issues.assessment: Spaces/NAS/restart issue never isolated; shell escaping is not evidence of correct GUI path handling.
requirements: Use native path values, not shell-escaped strings
cover spaces, quotes, NAS and offline mounts.

issues.title: Error Shazaming file - invalid data type
issues.assessment: M4A invalid-data Shazam report reportedly worked on dev build; no current fixture or API availability was verified.
requirements: If recognition is pursued later, use bundled decoding, opt-in external identification and bounded errors.

issues.title: a
issues.assessment: Issue body and title are only the letter a; no actionable report.
requirements: No integration requirement.

issues.title: Edit Tags - multiple file selection
issues.assessment: Edit Tags lacks multi-file metadata edits; suggested track deletion does not satisfy requested tag clearing.
requirements: Support batch keep/set/clear and mixed-value inspection with selected-track scope and diff.

issues.title: [Fixed] Juno artcover problem
issues.assessment: User confirmed a development build restored Juno cover art; this historical resolution is not current source availability proof.
requirements: Test artwork metadata separately from track matching and validate missing/blocked images without false success.

issues.title: Spotify tagging no longer working.
issues.assessment: Users report9to22hour stalls and no UI warning/fallback. Current source errors above600seconds but still uses recursive sleeps without total budget/cancel.
requirements: Provider pause/fallback must not make entire Incoming queue appear frozen.

issues.assessment: Issue body is only ellipses and no discussion, so no substantive feature or defect can be derived.
requirements: No implementation requirement inferred from empty issue.

issues.title: Feature request: Proper docker support (and more)
issues.assessment: Full thread explicitly says OneTagger is insecure by design; source still has dedicated server/socket architecture. Later CLI-only/server/port fixes do not add authentication or make it suitable for CueRithm.
requirements: Keep desktop-only Tauri boundary; do not import webserver, exposed file access or Docker runtime as part of tagging.

issues.title: Using Auto-tag corrupts m4a files
issues.assessment: M4A audio reportedly became flat after tagging; no reproducible sample or confirmed root cause/fix in discussion. Do not repeat as proven current corruption.
requirements: Require staged writes, audio-stream hashes and decode checks before replacing originals.

issues.title: FEATURE REQUEST - SUB GENRE in different column
issues.assessment: Separate subgenre native destination improves workflow; custom-section workaround exists upstream and later dedicated setting claimed.
requirements: Use shared category taxonomy with per-format export mappings and same-region genre/subgenre controls.

issues.title: Comments won't transfer to Apple Music app
issues.assessment: Final discussion traced invisible comments to COMM language xxx versus eng; CueRithm already has comment-language settings and format-specific writer.
requirements: Use readable format aliases and validated comment language; distinguish COMM from custom TXXX comment.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Add "Mixed Case" function to capitalize the 1st letter of each word of a string
issues.assessment: Titlecase function was added and exists in parser.
requirements: Expose opt-in titlecase with preview; preserve intentional artist spelling by default.

issues.title: Genres not being overwritten
issues.assessment: Discussion combines missing Spotify genres, mixed separators and later API change; overwrite alone does not create missing source values.
requirements: Preview missing source fields and native tokenization
report provider coverage distinctly from overwrite policy.

issues.title: beatbort tags all fail
issues.assessment: Reporter solved then-current Beatport failure by downloading newer app, demonstrating release discoverability matters; not proof current endpoint is healthy.
requirements: Ship provider fixes in supported releases with visible health/version status, not expiring Actions artifacts.

issues.title: Include the music key in the audio feature properties
issues.assessment: CueRithm already provides independent PCM key/energy and analysis tag writing, but requested key-energy comment composition is not proven delivered by this check. Spotify feature fetch is disabled upstream.
requirements: Preserve separate analysis provenance and configurable tag composition.

issues.title: Permission denied when running one tagger as debian-transmission
issues.assessment: Daemon account could not write config directory; ownership fix reported, not a tagging algorithm issue.
requirements: Return contextual app-data permission errors
never panic or silently use defaults on unwritable configuration.

issues.title: Edit Tags: Missing Title Tag (M4A)
issues.assessment: M4A title atom was absent from editor dropdown until claimed patch; raw fields need complete semantic aliases.
requirements: Use validated semantic field catalog for all formats and allow expert raw names without hiding standard title.

issues.title: Avto cue in quck tag
issues.assessment: Upstream declined cues; CueRithm already owns validated Lexicon-compatible cue analysis and native DJ sync. This is not functionality to extract from OneTagger.
requirements: Retain existing cue DSP and platform-specific sync acceptance boundaries.

issues.title: Suggestion: "Sort by"
issues.assessment: Alphabetical taxonomy sort and artwork drag replacement were reportedly added; sort-values label confused presentation and serialization order.
requirements: Provide clear taxonomy reorder/sort controls and safe artwork drag/drop preview
use semantic color selection.

issues.title: Shazam
issues.assessment: Discussion alternates working/failing Shazam and eventually rate-limit/retry hypothesis; no universal decoder or API fix follows.
requirements: External recognition stays optional with bounded retries, cooldown and distinct decode/network/no-match failures.

issues.title: Trying to overwrite only Genre, but all tags get overwritten
issues.assessment: Posted config sets overwrite=true, which intentionally overrides overwriteTags; owner explained it. This report does not prove a writer bug.
requirements: Replace contradictory overwrite controls with unambiguous per-field policy and recipe summary.

issues.title: Adding a custom tag value while using Autotagger
issues.assessment: User needs fixed COMM value during autotag; forcing a custom provider for static metadata is avoidable complexity.
requirements: Add ordered typed metadata actions to Incoming profiles with append/replace and explicit field policies.

issues.title: Allow me to provide the beatport url for tagging
issues.assessment: Exact Beatport URL/release assignment is directly useful when automatic metadata is ambiguous; upstream points to ID tags/manual mode.
requirements: Allow paste ID/URL in candidate resolver and scope release assignment to explicit tracks.

issues.title: Maximum Capability / File Count?
issues.assessment: 100k-track stalls and700MBlogs evolved into a Spotify rate-limit diagnosis for one reporter, while others lacked final cause. No reliable maximum established.
requirements: Bound memory/logs, checkpoint jobs and expose provider wait versus per-file failure.

issues.title: Complex searches?
issues.assessment: Requested AND expression was answered with regex OR, illustrating semantic confusion rather than solved boolean search.
requirements: Use structured filters/smartlist rules with explicit AND/OR
do not label regex alternation as AND.

issues.title: Track seeker doesn't update when autoplaying next song?
issues.assessment: Autoplay seeker state lag was claimed fixed; reporter used an unofficial AppImage, limiting packaging inference.
requirements: Bind waveform/playhead/duration to actual playing track ID through autoplay transitions.

issues.title: Shazam error decoding response body
issues.assessment: Shazam response-decoding failures recurred after a claimed fix; macOS close crash is a separate subreport.
requirements: Recognition failure must fall back or enter review, with bounded retries and decoupled app shutdown.

issues.title: Matches with Bandcamp difficulty
issues.assessment: Bandcamp artist may be label uploader with real artist in title; blind split risks false matches and overwriting correct data.
requirements: Before Bandcamp reuse distinguish uploader/artist and preserve source identity
keep ambiguous result for review.

issues.title: Parse Metadata from filename problem
issues.assessment: Long thread establishes parser only falls back if title/artist missing, not authoritative override; owner changed whitespace and optional-regex handling. Ambiguous semantics caused multiple false failures.
requirements: Explicit missing-only versus replace-input parsing mode, live examples and validation; do not silently override pinned release IDs.

issues.title: Shazam Rate Limit
issues.assessment: Exponential capped retry was claimed and user confirmed improvement, but maintainer explicitly accepts stop waiting for current calls. Current STOP_TAGGING is checked outside fingerprint network call.
requirements: Pass cancellation and overall time budget through recognition and each backoff.

issues.title: Error Shazaming file
issues.assessment: Shazam API parse failures persist across dev builds; ISRC-based result is not evidence fingerprint recognition worked.
requirements: Make fingerprint lookup optional with explicit method/provenance and failure handling
defer until sustainable backend.

issues.title: Typing in the Input Folder field error
issues.assessment: Typing an incomplete source path triggered repeated dialogs; owner called it intentional then claimed fix.
requirements: Debounce and validate on confirmation; show inline path errors without modal loops while typing.

issues.title: Problem With .Flac Files
issues.assessment: Requester withdrew FLAC second-write theory after finding hidden files were the cause.
requirements: Show skipped hidden/permission-restricted inputs explicitly instead of reporting unexplained success.

issues.title: [Enhancement] add TIT3 frame in the list of ID3v2.4 variables
issues.assessment: TIT3/version alias is relevant to mix-sensitive names; raw frame access is not the same as safe portable fields.
requirements: Expose mix/version consistently in editor and rename template
provide container-specific mapping help.

issues.title: Is it possible to use the full release date instead of just the year?
issues.assessment: Issue includes incomplete dates and reported changed BPM despite opt-out; owner could not explain grid issue. CueRithm already separates measured analysis and tests selected/unselected fields, but old files were not reproduced.
requirements: Preserve unselected BPM/private grid tags; represent date precision without inventing month/day.

issues.title: Traxsource Autotag causes 502 Bad Gateway - The server returned an invalid or incomplete response.
issues.assessment: Reports/replies attribute502access blocks to requests and advise single worker/newer build. Current cap1exists but HTML adapter lacks explicit delays/status semantics; no live recovery verified.
requirements: Use respectful provider pacing and clear unavailable/block responses; never treat them as no-match.

issues.title: Rate limiting on Spotify
issues.assessment: Spotify provided multi-hour RetryAfter; suggestions to rotate apps are not an acceptable new workflow.
requirements: Bound waits and expose retry time/cancel
do not import credential rotation or legacy Spotify runtime.

issues.title: Original Year
issues.assessment: Discussion explicitly disclaims global original-date accuracy; current Discogs returns selected release year/date and truncates release candidates. Oldest candidate is not first release of the recording.
requirements: Separate original-release and edition dates with provenance and precision; preview date-only bulk changes and retain Undo.

issues.title: Failed tracks per run are not saved in an m3u
issues.assessment: Reporter found duplicated paths in failed M3Us. Current failed_files pushes errors per platform without dedup until success, consistent with potential duplicate outcomes.
requirements: Emit each final failed track once and preserve detailed attempt history separately.

issues.title: Cannot upload playlist
issues.assessment: M3U upload fix reports only partial testing; discussion adds six-figure scale, normalization and native FLAC mapping concerns.
requirements: Use durable library scopes and scalable paging
validate search normalization and tag mapping with independent readers.

issues.title: Shazam recognition. Tags not automatically written to files after successful recognition
issues.assessment: Reporter and owner disagreed about which feature saved files; no reproducible root cause. This indicates inadequate distinction between match, draft and persisted write.
requirements: Make Matched, Unsaved and Saved states explicit; only successful verified publication is saved.

issues.title: Not responding
issues.assessment: Owner added artificial delay and high-limit error; reinstall did not reset persisted settings and long waits were not visible.
requirements: Provide reset recipe/control cancellation and provider-specific cooldown visibility.

issues.title: Various questions/suggestions/requests
issues.assessment: Search immediately after editing can lose changes despite autosave; comments also clarify selection, column order and boolean search gaps.
requirements: Commit/queue edits before filter/navigation/close and surface failures
preserve table preferences and selection.

issues.title: CTRL+S not working in Quick Tag
issues.assessment: Reporter says Ctrl+S writes but dirty prompt persists and modal buttons misbehave; owner acknowledged pending fix.
requirements: Dirty state clears only for matching acknowledged revision; test save/discard modal and repeated shortcuts.

issues.title: Suggestion: Option to write genres inline in Quicktag
issues.assessment: Request arbitrary one-off genre entry without adding a permanent taxonomy button.
requirements: Allow inline genre values alongside saved taxonomy groups.

issues.title: Switching folder in Quick Tag will throw away unsaved changes
issues.assessment: Changing folder drops last dirty track; developer acknowledged but no fix verified.
requirements: Never silently discard dirty metadata on folder/scope changes
await save or retain recoverable draft.

issues.title: OneTagger creates duplicate Genre fields for Flac and Vorbis files.
issues.assessment: Reporter resolved repeated native Vorbis values by configuring a separator; desired interoperability conflicts with native multi-value consumers in #222.
requirements: Retain arrays internally; choose explicit destination-compatible serialization without treating repeated values as inherently corrupt.

issues.title: Unexpected renaming file names
issues.assessment: Unexpected naming/title behavior on suspected network mount never got filesystem/OS details or resolution.
requirements: Test mounted paths and log frozen old/new paths without silently altering filenames during enrichment.

issues.title: AUTO TAG Fails to Match on Deezer When Multiple Artists Are Present
issues.assessment: Deezer multiartist mismatch remains reported without resolution; current CueRithm does not import provider.
requirements: Before adding Deezer normalize contributor arrays and test multiartist search separately from fuzzy threshold.

issues.title: AutoTag by albums + confirm saving
issues.assessment: CD/compilation folder tagging and manual approval requested; owner deferred album support. Manual confirmation belongs to existing-library/manual work, not the automatic success path.
requirements: Add release-scoped candidate review, keep successful configured Incoming unattended.

issues.title: FLAC file Not Working
issues.assessment: FLAC with ID3 header and renamed-extension confusion resolved after acquiring clean files; not proof24bitFLAC unsupported.
requirements: Sniff container/codec and distinguish wrong extension or foreign headers without mutating source.

issues.title: Feature Request: WavPack Support
issues.assessment: WavPack/DSD requires APE support and decoding beyond current requested common-format matrix.
requirements: Defer until demand and complete decode/play/edit compatibility are validated.

issues.title: READ BEFORE OPENING ISSUES
issues.assessment: Pinned maintainer note says partially maintained with delayed fixes, throttled providers and far-future album/plugin work; later Traxsource failure reinforces fragility. It does not prove formal abandonment.
requirements: Maintain selected adapters independently, publish provider diagnostics and do not inherit upstream release cadence as reliability guarantee.

issues.title: [ERROR] Parsing: delimiter not found
issues.assessment: Delimiter-not-found errors recur, including after QuickTag save; sample supplied a year later, no root cause/fix established.
requirements: Fixture malformed/duplicate ID3 text encodings and post-write reopen; keep affected tracks visible.

issues.title: Genres on 2 lines
issues.assessment: Single-row genres require horizontal hunting with large taxonomy; no discussion supplies a tested fix.
requirements: Wrap/search taxonomy chips and retain usable player/table at narrow widths.

issues.title: Mood replacing vibes on update
issues.assessment: Current QuickTag mood writes a scalar replacement to its raw destination; configuring mood and vibes into COMM can overwrite unrelated values as described.
requirements: Detect shared output mappings and perform one ownership-aware merge per field; preserve unrelated comments and categories.

issues.title: Menage the tags of AAC files
issues.assessment: Question concerned protected subscription downloads; owner clarified only ordinary DRM-free M4A/MP4 supported.
requirements: Do not add DRM circumvention or streaming-download handling.

issues.title: OneTagger Crashes on Exit
issues.assessment: macOS exit crash acknowledged as upstream webview problem; original shell is not reused.
requirements: Validate clean Tauri shutdown and job recovery
do not inherit upstream webview/server shell.

issues.title: onetagger can't get cover art from beatport
issues.assessment: Connection refused at media host is not proof bad image parsing; owner only requested newer build.
requirements: Separate image download/network failure from missing artwork and from successful metadata matching.

issues.title: Ignore fields
issues.assessment: Regex/bracket removal and oldest-release preference exist but do not guarantee original edition; requester also wants first-genre-only policy and bulk reset.
requirements: Separate query normalization, edition identity, genre cardinality and bulk clear actions.

issues.title: Application crashing when dragging/dropping to the "Select Input" of Auto Tag
issues.assessment: macOS folder drag crash might improve after webview updates but was never confirmed resolved.
requirements: Test native drag/drop folder ingestion on each OS
preserve browse fallback and avoid blocking UI.

issues.title: ''NoTag: reader does not contain an id3 tag'' ERROR message
issues.assessment: Closed inactivity was followed by users still reporting no-tag files on stable release; current QuickTag loads with create=false and requires title/artist.
requirements: Permit safe creation of absent tags for editable supported files; do not confuse no tag with malformed existing tag.

issues.title: OGG Vorbis files not considered as valid input?
issues.assessment: Support claim covers Vorbis yet no failing fixture supplied; current loader requires existing VorbisComments, which can exclude otherwise valid audio.
requirements: Support/tag-diagnose valid empty-comment Vorbis files and test Opus separately.

issues.title: Not inserting lyrics tag?
issues.assessment: Synchronized lyrics only on MP3 versus sidecar confused output behavior; not central to DJ-library management.
requirements: Do not expand Incoming with lyrics until clear use case and format support matrix.

issues.title: Tags getting reverted while search is active
issues.assessment: Search-filter editing reportedly reverted values; owner claimed fix without supplied regression evidence.
requirements: Key edits and save replies by stable track ID, never filtered row index; test filter/sort changes during save.

issues.title: Spotify connection
issues.assessment: Wrong port redirect advice corrected to36913; later auth problem still open. Current exact loopback URI exists, but current API access not verified.
requirements: Keep optional provider auth health and visible redirect/copy-URL recovery.

issues.title: ID3 Tag getting corrupted / Tag4All deletes ALL tags
issues.assessment: Reported unreadable Traktor tags and subsequent TagScanner loss lack isolated cause; cannot simply blame another app.
requirements: Use copied fixtures and independent parser roundtrips
preserve unknown frames and recoverable originals.

issues.title: Album art appears in apps like Rekordbox but wont appear in windows file explorer and I'm not sure why
issues.assessment: Discussion blames Windows ID3 version visibility, but no actual file comparison was performed here.
requirements: Document destination support and verify ID3v2.3/v2.4 artwork in target software separately from file readback.

issues.title: Onetagger-cli command with m3u file instead of path
issues.assessment: Owner added M3U path input; current CLI detects playlist extension and loads it.
requirements: Headless recipes should accept explicit track list/playlist scopes.

issues.title: ''Missing artist tag''
issues.assessment: Missing artist blocks old Quick Tag despite file being playable; browsing/tag editing should not require catalog-ready metadata.
requirements: Allow blank fields in library/editor and offer filename parse/manual correction before enrichment.

issues.title: Option to bypass brackets ignore?
issues.assessment: Reporter corrected initial brackets hypothesis: prior Shazam identification had changed metadata. Do not propagate the original unverified diagnosis.
requirements: Show matching-input provenance and allow clean correction without deleting source tags.

issues.title: Not seeing AAC files.
issues.assessment: AAC extension invisible because only AAC in MP4/M4A supported; source extension list confirms no rawADTS.
requirements: Keep CueRithm raw AAC/ADTS decode/tag-or-sidecar behavior explicit and tested.

issues.title: Can you add Chinese Music Streaming 163 Music Platform?
issues.assessment: 163 Music request has no implementation evidence or established DJ coverage gain.
requirements: Defer provider-specific expansion pending access contract and demonstrated catalog need.

issues.title: how to write a musical key?

requirements: Offer explicit musical/Camelot rendering in templates without changing stored measured key.

issues.title: Deezer Tags Locale
issues.assessment: Current Deezer content_language option implements requested English metadata independent of OS.
requirements: Store provider locale in recipe and do not derive content language silently from OS.

issues.title: Bypass album cover fetching
issues.assessment: CueRithm separates selected AlbumArt and overwrite policy; key-only work should preserve custom artwork.
requirements: Test key-only run makes no artwork network/write changes and retains existing cover bytes.

issues.title: Automatically detect key
issues.assessment: Requested local key detection is already central to CueRithm; no new catalog-based inference engine needed.
requirements: Preserve measured offline key analysis independent of provider coverage.

issues.title: Artwork not being scraped from Traxsource
issues.assessment: Log marks track successful despite Invalid album art; writer intentionally warns on art errors and still saves metadata.
requirements: Show required/optional enrichment failures per field and verify embedded image bytes/type.

issues.title: Can't open app
issues.assessment: Unsigned macOS app cannot open; workaround closure is not a release integrity solution.
requirements: Deliver signed/notarized supported packages
never instruct bypassing Gatekeeper as product flow.

issues.title: Half Star Ratings for Energy
issues.assessment: Half-star request used stars as energy; owner explains integer POPM interoperability. This is not a reason to replace CueRithm's 1-10 measured energy.

issues.title: Label tag for FLAC

requirements: Keep canonical label and compatibility mappings per target reader.

issues.title: Auto Tag - Little to no feedback for error states

keep diagnostics redacted and exportable.

requirements: Include portable version token and preserve original mix distinctions in templates.

issues.title: Mood, Energy co.

requirements: Provide destination-aware field hints and Sync mappings rather than promising file tags universally update DJ databases.

issues.title: "popularimeter" STAR Incorrect
issues.assessment: Current POPM51step versus RATINGWMP1/64/128/192/255 mapping matches owner explanation but is not universal reader agreement.
requirements: Model rating semantic value separately from target encoding and verify1through5andclear.

issues.title: MOOD COLOR TO COLOR TRACK SOFTWARE
issues.assessment: Mood-to-DJ color request requires native databases, not portable audio tags; CueRithm has dedicated sync adapters.
requirements: Define explicit mood/category-to-target color mapping in Sync, separate from taxonomy display color.

issues.title: column tagger
issues.assessment: CueRithm already uses its own dense configurable table instead of upstream stacked headers; this request reinforces keeping that design, not copying QT layout.
requirements: Keep headers aligned and each visible metadata column sortable where implemented; responsive/keyboard acceptance for added fields.

issues.title: LANGUAGE CHANGE

requirements: Use translatable UI strings and portable secret-free recipes when localization is prioritized.

issues.title: Seek not working >Actions Build

requirements: Use bundled playback clock and seek tests across formats
test native folder drive access independently.

issues.title: NEW Idea for identified tagging
issues.assessment: Upstream declined source badges because it had no DB; CueRithm already stores matching/cleanup provenance, providing a better foundation for an inspector.
requirements: Expose per-field source and transformation provenance instead of one misleading whole-track provider badge.

issues.title: Tags don't update in Apple Music (and recovered album art is not displayed correctly.)
issues.assessment: File tags/art are visible in Finder but stale in Apple Music database; discussion distinguishes cache refresh and suggests external scripts.
requirements: Report file-write completion separately from external-library refresh/sync acceptance.

issues.title: Traxsource Cover and Release Year  + write generic release date
issues.assessment: Traxsource manual results lacked cover/date; updated build reportedly fixed both and date confusion resolved via ID3 version.
requirements: Enrich selected candidate before apply
show date/cover with clear native date policy and target tests.

issues.title: AI to clean auto tag of genres?
issues.assessment: User wants constrained genres; CueRithm already supports deterministic saved canonical mappings/protected values. ChatGPT mood inference is an unverified separate proposal.
requirements: Prefer editable deterministic taxonomy rules over opaque paid AI; keep suggestions optional and separate from measured analysis.

issues.title: Bulk delete a tag?
issues.assessment: Bulk comment clearing required external Mp3tag; OneTagger lacked bulk solution in discussion.
requirements: Add explicit bulk field clear with preview and undo rather than requiring another tool.

issues.title: Invalid timestamp error
issues.assessment: Logs show both port collision and separate invalid timestamp on playerLoad; maintainer response addressed port only, not proof timestamp fixed.
requirements: Separate startup transport errors from malformed metadata/audio load errors
isolate bad track from session.

issues.title: CMD+C / CMD+V not works on macOS
issues.assessment: User confirmed development build fixed Cmd+C/Cmd+V; do not import old custom webview keyboard layer.
requirements: Retain native edit shortcuts and test copy/paste in template/raw-field/text inputs.

issues.title: Feature request: Show all tags even if they're empty
issues.assessment: Requester wants preset fields visible even when absent, reducing repeated raw-tag creation.
requirements: Show configured inspector fields with empty states and preserve raw advanced editor separately.

issues.title: [ERROR] onetagger_shared: PANIC: panicked at 'assertion failed: `(left == right)`
issues.assessment: ID3 assertion panic during large runs disappeared after external rewriting; underlying panic remains unproven and must not show false success.
requirements: Validate frame IDs and inputs
contain per-track failures and report exact affected identities without publishing private paths.

issues.title: Onetagger not seeing all music files in a playlist or folder
issues.assessment: Reporter found failed-to-load view but did not supply a final cause; no evidence all missing tracks are unmatched or corrupt.
requirements: Show inventory counts and precise per-file load/match status; repair missing metadata in place.

issues.title: Streaming tracks taging
issues.assessment: Streaming-track database tagging and proprietary DJCUintegration requested; upstream declined. Existing local native sync does not establish streaming entity compatibility.
requirements: Defer streaming-only track metadata until authoritative entity support is designed.

issues.title: guides and links from the app does not open in browser
issues.assessment: Arc/default-browser link launch failed; issue closure attributes external browser but no robust user recovery supplied.
requirements: Show copyable documentation/auth links and actionable launch errors.

issues.title: Tags not showing in rekordbox
issues.assessment: Rekordbox7 QuickTag visibility report remained unreproduced by collaborator; missing artists also hid some tracks. No universal reload fix is proven for this exact case.
requirements: Separate local metadata persistence from native destination refresh; preserve unsupported-field explanations and unknown-field editability.

issues.title: Ways of Auto-Renaming correctly the Remix artist into track Title
issues.assessment: Version/raw-tag access exists; optional whole-command disappearance can help conditional text, but upstream response only points to version and does not provide full requested rule.
requirements: Offer optional groups and explicit version/remixer tokens without duplicating OriginalMix or empty brackets.

issues.title: Audio features into custom mp3 fields
issues.assessment: Described COMM keys such as MediaMonkey custom fields need structured frame identity, not string concatenation guesswork.
requirements: Model language/description/text when advanced mapping is offered
preserve unrelated described comments.

issues.title: Audio features stopped working
issues.assessment: Owner explicitly says Audio Features is a Spotify wrapper and effectively dead after API changes; commenters' subjective accuracy opinions are not measurements.
requirements: Do not surface a working-looking Audio Features stage; use CueRithm's existing offline measured analysis.

issues.title: Please, can you add a neutralizer/gainer also?
issues.assessment: Unspecified neutralizer/gainer request; no OneTagger implementation to reuse.
requirements: If pursued, separately design non-destructive loudness metadata; do not change audio implicitly.

issues.title: Comments field [COMM] not updating on iTunes/Apple Music
issues.assessment: Reporter confirms eng language fixed Apple Music visibility; CueRithm defaults eng and exposes override.
requirements: Retain logical default comment identity and verify interoperability beyond in-app readback.

issues.title: Audio Features 403 - Except for this, it would be a perfect program! (Keep up the great work!)
issues.assessment: 403 was linked to Spotify removal; later Soundnet suggestion is an unvalidated paid alternative, not a replacement already available.
requirements: Do not add third-party audio feature APIs merely to recreate excluded danceability/valence workflows.

issues.assessment: Upstream Opus recognition fails for reported sample; CueRithm owns bundled PCM decoding, so reuse that foundation rather than importing upstream player. New recognition support remains unimplemented and requires its own acceptance proof.

issues.title: Some artists seemingly not properly picked up on Beatport
issues.assessment: Short artist T78 not matched; no diagnosis or confirmed fix beyond try-dev-build suggestion.
requirements: Add short/numeric artist fixtures and provider-query diagnostics before changing global threshold.

issues.title: When compiling, error about not being able to find the style sheet
issues.assessment: Quasar stylesheet compile failure belongs to the Vue upstream UI being excluded, not CueRithm React design integration.
requirements: Do not import upstream frontend build system.

issues.title: Comments for FLACs in Rekordbox only showing first value
issues.assessment: Rekordbox reportedly shows only first multivalue COMMENT; no discussion/fix. Native tag validity is not proof of consumer display.

issues.title: Playlists autotag error

issues.title: skip file Shazam: error decoding response body: expected value at line 1 column 1

do not recommend ABI symlink hacks.

issues.title: Sort by date created or added when quick tagging
issues.assessment: Date-created/added sorting is valuable for preparing recent arrivals and fits existing table instead of a separate file browser.
requirements: Expose added/date sorting and preserve stable selection during order changes.

issues.assessment: External player action is OS-open-file, not a player control protocol; continue-playback behavior differs intentionally but could be improved with launching each selected file.
requirements: Keep internal player authoritative and label external-open behavior accurately.

issues.title: Space and Comma added automatically in front of comments when tagging for TRAKTOR
issues.assessment: Maintainer reproduces leading comma after clear-then-add across FLAC/WAV; separator bug not reliably fixed by ordering workaround.

issues.title: Not Tagging Whole Library

requirements: Resume durably after batch interruption and make skip markers/output mappings inspectable; large-library performance acceptance required.

issues.title: Multiselect ranges with shift modifier (in Quick Tag UI)
issues.assessment: Shift-click range requested viaPR451; conversation distinguishes keyboard ranges and additive selection. Closure alone does not prove merge/runtime behavior.
requirements: Standardize shift-click/keyboard range selection across shared track table.

issues.title: Autotag is not working from some platforms
issues.assessment: Traxsource/Juno stopped working in stable release; thread discusses old release versus dev builds, not verified current outage.
requirements: Keep Traxsource fixtures/live health distinct
gate Juno adoption on maintained adapter and visible availability.

issues.title: All programs are skipping over every track

issues.title: Unable To Remove Star Ratings

never treat string as character list.

issues.title: Format tags so they are available on CDJs and Rekordbox "My tags"
issues.assessment: Request explicitly seeks native MyTags/CDJfiltering; discussion explains comment formatting alone cannot update the database.
requirements: Define structured taxonomy-to-native MyTags mapping in existing sync; prove CDJ acceptance separately.

preserve source unchanged.

require review for ambiguity and provide optional batch preview with reject/tweak/source override.

issues.title: Write album art to file stuck on

requirements: Saved artwork destination must be authoritative across restart; verify sidecar absence when embed-only or art disabled.

preflight full batch and report per-file conflicts with deterministic safe alternative names.

issues.title: Wrong data in renamed file

issues.title: Converting Quick Tag Custom Sections into Comments with Section as Description and Comma Separated Values as Comment
issues.assessment: Category-as-COMM-description is useful explicit interoperability mapping, not safe default for all tag consumers.
requirements: Keep category IDs in library
offer opt-in described-comment mapping and target-reader fixtures.

issues.title: Importing settings from other PC
